# UNIÓN Y CURACIÓN DE DATOS (MCA)

```{r}
# data
M <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/USUARIO/Desktop/GIT/GrainStorage/manuscript/metadata.csv",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM",
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```
```{r}
# DICCIONARIO DE NORMALIZACIÓN
dic <- c(
  "infusorial earth" = "diatomaceous earth",
  "diatomaceous earths" = "diatomaceous earth",
  "phosphines" = "phosphine",
  "monoterpene" = "monoterpenes",
  "insecticide" = "insecticides",
  "pesticide" = "pesticides",
  "essential oil" = "essential oils",
  "plant extract" = "plant extracts",
  "biopesticide" = "biopesticides",
  "moth" = "moths",
  "diatomite" = "diatomaceous earth",
    "fungus" = "fungi",
  "insect repellent" = "insect repellents",
  "biological control agent" = "biological control agents"
)

```
```{r}
# 3. FUNCIÓN DE NORMALIZACIÓN
normalizar <- function(x) {

  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(trimws(x))) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  terminos <- trimws(tolower(
    unlist(strsplit(x, ";", fixed = TRUE))
  ))

  terminos <- gsub("\\s+", " ", terminos)
  terminos <- terminos[nzchar(terminos)]

  # Sustituir términos equivalentes
  idx <- terminos %in% names(dic)
  terminos[idx] <- unname(dic[terminos[idx]])

  # Eliminar duplicados dentro del documento
  terminos <- unique(terminos)

  paste(terminos, collapse = ";")
}

```
```{r}

# BASE NORMALIZADA
M_mca <- M

M_mca$ID <- vapply(
  M$ID,
  normalizar,
  character(1)
)
```
```{r}
# MCA
set.seed(123)

CS <- conceptualStructure(
  M_mca,
  field = "ID",
  method = "MCA",
  minDegree = 5,
  clust = "auto",
  k.max = 8,
  stemming = FALSE
)

# 6. MOSTRAR GRÁFICO
print(CS$graph_terms)

# 7. VERIFICAR CLÚSTERES
table(CS$km.res$cluster)
```
```{r}

# RESULTADOS
salida <- "C:/Users/USUARIO/Desktop/GIT/GrainStorage/files/Data/MCA_Resultados"

dir.create(salida, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# FIGURA
ggsave(
  file.path(salida, "Figure_7.png"),
  plot = CS$graph_terms,
  width = 14,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(salida, "MCA_ID_Normalizado.pdf"),
  plot = CS$graph_terms,
  width = 14,
  height = 9
)

# PALABRAS CLAVE POR CLÚSTER
tabla_clusters <- data.frame(
  Palabra_clave = names(CS$km.res$cluster),
  Cluster = as.integer(CS$km.res$cluster)
)

# RESUMEN DE CLÚSTERES
resumen_clusters <- as.data.frame(
  table(tabla_clusters$Cluster)
)

names(resumen_clusters) <- c(
  "Cluster", "Numero_palabras"
)

# COORDENADAS FACTORIALES
coordenadas <- data.frame(
  Palabra_clave = rownames(CS$km.res$data.clust),
  CS$km.res$data.clust,
  row.names = NULL
)

# INERCIA EXPLICADA
inercia <- data.frame(
  Dimension = rownames(CS$res$eig),
  CS$res$eig,
  row.names = NULL
)

# EXPORTAR
write.xlsx(
  list(
    Palabras_por_cluster = tabla_clusters,
    Resumen_clusters = resumen_clusters,
    Coordenadas_MCA = coordenadas,
    Inercia_MCA = inercia
  ),
  file = file.path(salida, "Resultados_MCA_ID.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

# ANÁLISIS
saveRDS(
  CS,
  file.path(salida, "MCA_ID_Completo.rds")
)

# VERIFICAR RESULTADOS
print(resumen_clusters)

cat("\nArchivos guardados en:\n", salida, "\n")

```


#ANÁLISIS DE LA PRODUCCION CIENTIFICA MUNDIAL

```{r}
data <- convert2df("C:/Users/USUARIO/Desktop/GIT/GrainStorage/files/data/metadata.csv",
                   dbsource = "scopus", format = "csv")

data$TC <- as.numeric(data$TC)

produccion_citas_anio <- data %>%
  group_by(PY) %>%
  summarise(
    Articulos = n(),
    Citas = sum(TC, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(PY)

print(produccion_citas_anio)

write_xlsx(produccion_citas_anio,
           "C:/Users/USUARIO/Desktop/GIT/GrainStorage/files/results_xlsx/produccion_citas_por_año.xlsx")
```

```{r}
# Data
data <- read_excel("C:/Users/USUARIO/Desktop/GIT/GrainStorage/files/results_xlsx/produccion_citas_por_año.xlsx")
head(data)
```
```{r}
data$Año <- as.numeric(data$Año)
data$Articulos <- as.numeric(data$Articulos)
data$Citas <- as.numeric(data$Citas)

factor_citas <- 160 / 1600


P1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Año)) +

  geom_col(aes(y = Articulos, fill = "Publications"), alpha = 0.7, width = 0.7) +
  
  geom_line(aes(y = Citas * factor_citas, color = "Citations"), size = 0.8, lineend = "round") +
  geom_point(aes(y = Citas * factor_citas, color = "Citations"), size = 2) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Publications",
    limits = c(0, 160),
    breaks = seq(0, 160, 20),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~./factor_citas, name = "Citations", breaks = seq(0, 1600, 200))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(data$Año), max(data$Año), by = 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = c("Publications" = "#5DADE2"), guide = guide_legend(order = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "", values = c("Citations" = "#990000"), guide = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Year"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray80", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  )

print(P1)
```

```{r}
ggsave("C:/Users/USUARIO/Desktop/GIT/GrainStorage/files/Figuras/produccion_citas_por_año.jpg",

       dpi = 300,
       bg = "white")
```
